experiment: Phase 3.0 NCU capability reprobe on fresh A40 host
conclusion: Hardware performance counters remain blocked by RunPod host policy (ERR_NVGPUCTRPERM). Phase 3.4 will use Nsight Systems only.

host_profiling_diagnostics.interpretation: Host restricts GPU performance counters to administrators. Container root lacks CAP_SYS_ADMIN and CAP_PERFMON, so NCU hardware-counter collection is denied.

ncu_probes.notes: Connected and profiled a kernel launch, but LaunchStats does not include SM/DRAM/Tensor Core hardware metrics. Warning: No metrics to collect found in sections for some passes.
